claim_text: In a cohort of 2,432 individuals referred for NF1 molecular diagnosis, NIH criteria had sensitivity 58.2% and specificity 88.6% for detecting a pathogenic NF1 or SPRED1 variant in children under 7 years, versus sensitivity 85.3% and specificity 74.3% at age 7 or older.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Data cited from a primary study (secondary citation in a consensus paper): Messiaen et al. (ref 14 of the consensus paper).
